meta.name: render-reftest
meta.description: Design, review, and debug visual rendering tests: reftests (independent oracle), golden/snapshot regression tests, probe tests (pixel assertions without vision), SVG reftest suites, and Figma refig suites. Use when adding pixel diffs, choosing an oracle strategy, or comparing renderer output against a ground truth.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计、审查和调试视觉渲染测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在渲染输出与基准之间进行像素级对比测试
copy.tagline_en: Design, review, and debug visual rendering tests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need pixel-level comparison between renderer output and ground truth

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你设计、审查和调试视觉渲染测试，包括参考测试、黄金回归测试、探针测试、SVG 参考测试套件和 Figma 参考测试套件。它会根据你的需求推荐最合适的测试类型和工具。
howto.when: 当你需要添加像素对比测试、选择测试策略（参考测试/黄金测试/探针测试），或比较渲染器输出与标准结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个 SVG 文件设计一个参考测试。
say.note: Claude 会分析 SVG 并推荐测试策略。

say.text: 这个渲染结果应该用黄金测试还是探针测试？
say.note: Claude 会根据你的场景给出建议。

say.text: 帮我审查这个 PR 中的黄金图像更新。
say.note: Claude 会检查图像差异和测试合理性。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you design, review, and debug visual rendering tests including reftests, golden/snapshot regression tests, probe tests, SVG reftest suites, and Figma refig suites. It recommends the most suitable test type and tools based on your needs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to add pixel comparison tests, choose a test strategy (reftest/golden/probe), or compare renderer output against a ground truth.

say_en.text: Help me design a reftest for this SVG file.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the SVG and recommend a strategy.

say_en.text: Should this rendering use a golden test or a probe test?
say_en.note: Claude will advise based on your scenario.

say_en.text: Review the golden image updates in this PR.
say_en.note: Claude will check image diffs and test validity.
